_comment: VPS runtime settings. Secrets stay in .env.
_yadisk_folder_comment: Active event media folder. Session notifications arrive through yadisk_control_folder/to_vps.
_yadisk_control_folder_comment: Stable private bus with only to_booth and to_vps. Processed command and response JSON files are deleted. Must match the photobooth config.

archive_delivery._comment: Independent automatic media archive circuits for completed sessions and accepted remote prints.

ai_image_edit._comment: Outside cafe mode, a photo enters this flow only when its caption is exactly AI, ИИ or изменить. In cafe mode AI is available only to admins and allowlisted users. KIE_API_KEY stays in .env. Output is always 1K; source orientation automatically selects 3:2 or 2:3.

templates.prompt: Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them in dynamic, glamorous superstar poses with high-fashion clothing, dramatic professional lighting, and an elegant premier event environment. Keep the overall look polished, flattering, and suitable for a premium 10x15 print. Do not generate any text, letters, logos or watermarks.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Create a vibrant, festive magazine cover composition. Surround the main subjects with stylish, celebratory Russian text, catchy headlines, and typographic elements that complement their appearance and the holiday mood, wrapping around them beautifully like on a premium lifestyle or fashion magazine cover. Do not generate any unrelated watermarks or logos.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them as iconic figures from a nostalgic Soviet-era postcard or vintage poster. Use authentic cinematic retro lighting, iconic mid-20th-century retro attire, and a warm, slightly grainy, celebratory film-like atmosphere. The composition should look like a cherished, classic artistic postcard from the past.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them as characters on a stylish, premium fantasy or superhero collectible gaming card, complete with an elegant, thematic card border. Add minimal, humorous and witty Russian text, funny titles, or silly stat labels integrated seamlessly into the card design, matching the subjects' unique appearance and playful vibe.

Preserve the recognizable identities, ages, facial features, skin tones and expressions of the main subjects in the foreground. Reimagine them as stylish, collectible toy dolls or action figures packaged inside a premium cardboard toy box with a clear, glossy transparent plastic front window. Arrange themed miniature toy accessories and cool props neatly inside the packaging beside them. The overall presentation should look like a mint-condition, professionally designed retail action figure blister pack.

Preserve the recognizable identities and key facial features of the main subjects in the foreground. Create one polished three-panel comic composition telling a short celebratory visual story, with consistent character appearance of the main subjects across all panels and clear panel separation. Leave speech areas empty. Do not generate any text, letters, logos or watermarks.
